hf_basic_evidence.title: MicroDuck Playground
hf_basic_evidence.purpose: 已发现相关模型或资料，但说明不足，具体用途与研究方向待核实。
hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# microduck-chimney-climb

A MicroDuck policy that climbs a narrow vertical corridor by bracing between
two walls. The **climbing policy is the main model**; companion enter and exit
policies are included to connect the climb to the floor and a top platform.

**Status: simulation-only research release; not validated on hardware.**
The video is a selected successful enter–climb–exit–get-up sequence, not a
robustness benchmark or an autonomous perception demonstration.

[Open the final MP4](replay.mp4). The ending uses Pollen Robotics' unchanged
official `alpha_stand.onnx` recovery policy, not a fourth policy trained here.

## Policies

| Role | Files | Selected checkpoint |
|---|---|---|
| **Main: climb** | [`policy.onnx`](policy.onnx), [`checkpoint.pt`](checkpoint.pt) | w17; stored iteration99,250 |
| Enter the corridor | [`enter/policy.onnx`](enter/policy.onnx), [`enter/checkpoint.pt`](enter/checkpoint.pt) | a11; stored iteration25,500 |
| Exit onto the platform | [`exit/policy.onnx`]

hf_basic_evidence.title: craigm26/duckbatch
hf_basic_evidence.purpose: 已发现相关模型或资料，但说明不足，具体用途与研究方向待核实。
hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# craigm26/microduck-duckbatch-b002-256x128x64

A walking policy for Pollen Robotics' [Microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck):
57,934 parameters (61-256-128-64-14), distilled from Pollen's
default walker (`velstand.onnx`, 197,774 parameters) by
[duckbatch](https://github.com/craigm26/duckbatch), batch `b002-student-size-longer`, attempt `a01`.

**[Drive it in your browser](https://pollen-robotics-microduck-simulator.hf.space/?move=craigm26/microduck-duckbatch-b002-256x128x64)** (Pollen's simulator loads it from this repo).

**Simulation only.** It has never run on a real robot. A student that matches the teacher in
mjlab is a candidate for a hardware test, not a result about hardware.

## Measured

`mjlab` `Mjlab-VelStand-Flat-MicroDuck` with domain randomization, stumble pushes and observation noise on;
the task's deliberate prone spawns and topple pushes are off for the walking numbers and on
(every episode prone) for the get-up numbers.
30 s per seed on held-out se

hf_update_notes.summary: # duckbatch-b003b Book 4's b003b: duckbatch's 26,254-parameter student of Pollen's walk, fine-tuned in simulation with progress terms. Sim only, never run on hardware. A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait for the `walk` slot. ## Run it on a robot ```bash sudo robotctl policy load walk craigm26/microduck-duckbatch-b003b ``` The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations. `manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo). A remix of [craigm26/microduck-duckbatch-b002-128x128](https://huggingface.co/craigm26/microduck-duckbatch-b002-128x128). ## Training - **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`

hf_update_notes.summary: # duckbatch-social Four ducks who have never met, each run by its own brain: a small behavior engine with states named after Pollen's docs/ideas/autonomous_behavior.md (Chill, LookAround, Wander, TurnInPlace, Greet, Dance, Nap). The brains ran closed loop inside the Arena's simulator, sensing every duck's true pose ten times a second, and this timeline is the record of what they chose. Three walkers are duckbatch's b003e (Book 4 at microduckstudio.com); the napping duck is Pollen's got-a-talent reference. Greetings play the curious and yes head moves from pollen-robotics/microduck-emotions; dances bob on a shared half-second beat. The same brain will drive live ducks next. A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). A PPO locomotion policy for the 14-actuator MicroDuck biped, trained in MuJoCo Warp through mjlab. The final policy achieves **1.50 m/s mean body-forward speed** in simulation at a 2.0 m/s command. **The sustained 2.0 m/s goal was not met.**

Experimental Stage 2.5 checkpoint with a 100-action (two-second at 50 Hz)

Forward roll from a standing start, trained in simulation only (mjlab / MuJoCo Warp, 10,000 iterations, 4096 envs, 173 min on one RTX 5090). Not yet tested on a real Microduck.

hf_basic_evidence.title: playground-competition
hf_basic_evidence.purpose: 已发现相关模型或资料，但说明不足，具体用途与研究方向待核实。
hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# Microduck Playground Competition

A browser-based MuJoCo racing game for three Microduck robots. Each duck runs
its own local physics simulation and locomotion policy in the browser. Pick a
winner, watch the ducks complete two laps around an oval playground, and earn
or lose fish according to your prediction.

The game is a front-end application: MuJoCo runs through WebAssembly and
`onnxruntime-web` evaluates the trained ONNX policies locally. There is no
Python server, inference API, database, or multiplayer backend required.

## Game rules

1. The game opens with a betting screen. The player starts with one fish and
   chooses Duck 1, Duck 2, or Duck 3.
2. All three ducks start from the same start/finish line on equivalent lanes.
   Their lanes have the same route length; the first duck is not placed ahead.
3. The ducks race in rollers mode by default. Press `M` to switch all three
   racers between rollers and feet.
4. The first duck to complete two laps reaches the winner podium.

# A fly connectome steering MicroDuck

We coupled a fixed spiking model of the full released FAFB v783 fly connectome (139,255 neurons; 15,091,983 directed connections) to an already trained MicroDuck locomotion policy.

Activity propagates through the fixed LIF network, and a trained 83,974-parameter readout maps 1,305 descending-neuron firing rates to forward, turn and stop commands. # Policies

The ONNX policies `robotd` runs. All of them are `obs[1,61] -> actions[1,14]`; `robotd`
checks that at load rather than discovering it mid-stride.

## This is a temporary home

**These belong on the Hugging Face Hub**, delivered as a `model` updater component that
versions independently of the daemon — a gait retrain should not need a daemon release, and a
daemon fix should not re-download 6 MB of unchanged weights. `deploy/updater.toml` already
describes that component and deliberately leaves it unconfigured until the repos exist.

They are vendored here because they were not on the Hub yet and the daemon cannot move without
them. Committing them makes a release self-contained, which is the property that makes the
update path testable end to end: one `robotctl update apply` turns a standing robot into a
walking one.

Removing this directory later is the whole migration: point the `[policy]` paths in
`deploy/robotd.toml` at wherever the model component ins

# 🦆 MicroDuck Bipedal Robot Simulation Trajectory Dataset

This dataset contains multi-modal **state-action trajectories** collected from the MicroDuck 14-DOF bipedal robot simulation in MuJoCo.

## 📂 Formats Available
1. **`.csv` files**: Human-readable tabular format containing timestamps, base pose (pos & quat), linear/angular velocities, 14 motor angles, velocities, applied torques (`ctrl`), and user velocity commands.
2. **`.npz` files**: Compressed NumPy tensor arrays (`obs`, `actions`, `joint_pos`, `joint_vel`, `ctrl`, `cmd_vel`, `base_pos`, `base_quat`, `timestamps`) designed for direct ingestion into PyTorch / Behavior Cloning / Offline RL training pipelines.

## 🚀 Quick Load Example (Python)
```python
import numpy as np

# Load trajectory tensor
data = np.load("duck_dataset_example.npz")
print("Observations shape:", data["obs"].shape)      # (N, 61)
print("Actions shape:", data["actions"].shape)       # (N, 14)
print("Joint Positions shape:", data["joint_pos"]

rows.evidence:
# peekaboo

Peekaboo: tucks its beak down to its chest, holds, then pops back up, four times in 18.8 s, with a quack on each reveal. Trained with PPO in MuJoCo on a laptop GTX 1650, 9,599 iterations.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> awanumair/microduck-peekaboo-talent
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **branch**: `main`

# Quack to the Future

Waddle today, time travel tomorrow. A **simulation-only MicroDuck Arena 2 m sprint checkpoint**, iteration **2150**.

The exact `policy.onnx` in this repository scored **1.020 s, 5/5 finishes** in the full official local CPU evaluator on 2026-10-22: all 21 forward commands from 0.20 to 1.20 m/s were scanned, the three finalists were evaluated on seeds 1–5, and 1.20 m/s won. Each selected-command seed finished in 1.020 s. This is a local verification; the public Arena independently evaluates submissions.

- `policy.onnx`: the evaluated 61-observation → 14-action policy, including its observation normalizer. Use raw Arena observations at 50 Hz.

# 🦆 MicroDuck 걷기 정책 — 한국어 실행 기록

[MicroDuck](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator)(Pollen Robotics의 25cm 이족보행 오리 로봇)에게 **걷는 법을 강화학습으로 가르친 정책**입니다.
걷는 방법은 코드 한 줄도 가르치지 않았습니다 — 시뮬레이션 속 가상 오리 4,096마리가 동시에 넘어지고 일어나며, PPO 알고리즘이 "잘 걸은 움직임"을 골라 뇌(신경망) 하나로 합쳐가는 방식입니다.

**마이크로덕 학습 파이프라인의 한국어 공개 기록**을 목표로, 실패를 포함한 전 과정을 기록하며 만들어졌습니다.

<video src="preview_walk.mp4" controls autoplay muted loop width="480"></video>

## 파일

| 파일 | 설명 |
|------|------|
| **`bruno_walk_v2.onnx`** | **평지 플래그십** — 2차 런(재개 학습)의 4,500 iteration 체크포인트. 졸업 시험 3종목(0.3/0.5 m/s 직진 + 회전 주행) 종합 1위 |
| **`bruno_walk_v4_rough.onnx`** | **험지 전문가** — v2 계보에서 거친 지형 태스크로 +3,000 iteration 파인튜닝. 2cm 자갈밭에서 v2는 넘어지지만 v4는 서서 전진합니다 (평지 속도는 v2의 절반 — 상황별 뇌 교체 용도) |
| `bruno_walk_3250it.onnx` | 1차 런 결과 (3,250 iteration에서 크레딧 소진으로 중단) |
| `preview_walk.mp4` | 졸업 모델의 0.5 m/s 고속 주행 — 10초 2.11m, 넘어짐 없음 |

## 졸업 시험 결과 (자체 벤치마크)

체크포인트를 37,250 iteration까지 뽑아 비교한 결과, **실력은 ~4,500 iteration에서 완성**되었고

# on-sourccey-dome

Stands on top of a moving Sourccey (3D-printed dome, R 0.194 m). Trained with robotd's target low-pass and standing gain; held-out full-Sourccey sim2sim with robotd tuning + hand placement 13/16 x 30 s (v4: 7/16).

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Holds until told otherwise; the daemon drives `command.idle` for 1.0 s before handing back to the gait.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy add on-sourccey-dome cetiennec/microduck-on-sourccey-dome --hold <seconds>
robotctl robot do on-sourccey-dome
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

A remix of [cetiennec/mos-dome-v4-20261009](https://huggingface.co/cetiennec/mos-dome-v4-20261009).

## Training

Own lineage: PPO from scratch (nb1, commit 46c48b1) continued as nb2 and nb4 (commit fac88cc), checkpoint 850 (1.328 s); evolution strategies on the weights against the Arena sprint scorer (0.952 s); then the network frozen and wrapped in a step counter carried in the head_roll action that adds joint-target and forward-command offsets from about 0.5 m to the line, found by CMA-ES on the event's official seeds: 0.940 s. No other entry's weights used. Simulation only.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> dadudu/microduck-bubu-sprint
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

该仓库保存 every-embodied 教程复现的 Microduck 右脚踢球策略。训练基于 `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl` 提交 `29e887ecfbf5d37144759e5a9f8a176dfb83d547`，任务为 `Mjlab-BallKick-Flat-MicroDuck`。

## 训练记录

- 并行环境：4096
- PPO 迭代：6000
- 累计 transition：589,824,000
- 训练耗时：2 小时 6 分 15 秒
- 最终 mean reward：89.42
- 最终 mean episode length：250.0
- 最终 `ball_forward_velocity` reward：11.4758

这些数值只描述本次运行，不应脱离代码提交、任务配置和随机种子作为跨项目榜单结果。

## 文件

- `model_5999.pt`：最终 RSL-RL checkpoint。
- `ball_kick_right_6000.onnx`：供 Microduck 61 维观测、14 维动作运行时使用的右脚策略。
- `microduck_ballkick_visual_qa.json`：训练、浏览器闭环、接触扫描与演示视频的机器可读记录。

## 校验值

```text
cf3f34ed68dec9137260d20f4e2cfdd507415df651d86fe31f2ac9daa8073c7c  model_5999.pt
bd03168c2554de6f95a69903143997c3ff85fec73c28a010225868216d3ea518  ball_kick_right_6000.onnx
```

## 使用边界

该策略不接收图像或球位置，只执行一次盲踢。教程网页使用独立的视觉检测接口和有限状态机完成找球、接近、脚位对齐与策略切换，并提供头部第一视角、近距离第二视角和居中第三视角。浏览器演示中的检测框由 MuJoCo 真值投影得到，用于验证控制接口，不代表训练或评测了视觉检测器。

完整说明、命令与视频见 [every-embodied](https://github.com/datawhalechi

# Microduck RL 4096x6000

这是 Every Embodied 为 Duck Together 共建计划完成的一次 Microduck 速度跟踪策略复现。训练基于 Pollen Robotics 的 [`microduck_rl`](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl)，使用 4096 个并行环境完成 6000 次 PPO 迭代，并保留中间 checkpoint、最终 ONNX、训练配置、TensorBoard 事件文件和连续闭环回放视频。

## 关键结果

| 项目 | 数值 |
|---|---:|
| 上游提交 | `29e887ecfbf5d37144759e5a9f8a176dfb83d547` |
| 训练任务 | `Mjlab-Velocity-Flat-MicroDuck` |
| 并行环境 | 4096 |
| PPO 迭代 | 6000 |
| 环境步数 | 589,824,000 |
| 训练耗时 | 01:27:41 |
| 最后一轮 mean reward | 119.57 |
| 最后一轮 mean episode length | 972.52 |
| ONNX 输入/输出 | `[1, 61] -> [1, 14]` |

这里的 reward 和 episode length 是训练进程最后一轮的日志值，不是跨随机种子或真机测试的独立 benchmark。使用者应结合视频、固定种子回放和自己的任务评测判断策略质量。

## 文件结构

```text
checkpoints/
  model_0.pt
  model_500.pt
  ...
  model_5500.pt
  model_5999.pt
configs/
  agent.yaml
  env.yaml
export/
  microduck_policy_5999.onnx
logs/
  events.out.tfevents.*
  every-embodied-4096x6000.log.gz
provenance/
  microduck_rl.diff
videos/
  walk_4096x6000.mp4
  command_dance_4096x6000.mp4

rows.evidence:
# daisy-bell

Daisy Bell: the duck sings the first song a computer ever sang, HAL 9000 style

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> DenRakEiw/microduck-daisy-bell
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

A remix of [pollen-robotics/microduck-got-a-talent-reference](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-got-a-talent-reference).

## Training

- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`
- **branch**: `main`
- **commit**: `a3e0c0fbe`
- exported from a checkout with uncommitted changes

hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# sprint-baseline

Mjlab-Sprint2m-MicroDuck

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> DenRakEiw/microduck-sprint-baseline
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **task_id**: `Mjlab-Sprint2m-MicroDuck`
- **repo**: `https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck-challenges`
- **branch**: `denrakeiw`
- **commit**: `9ffb700f2`
- **checkpoint**: `1000`
- **seed**: `1`
- **base**: `mjlab-microduck 0.1.0 @ 8d0dbc94c`
- **started**: `2026-10-12T15:18:39Z`

## Reproduce

Same code, same `uv.lock`, same command, same seed. Training it again yields a comparable policy, not the same weights

**Publisher**: `devorah-ai-2026` / `devorahai2026`  
**License**: `Commercial / CC-BY-SA 4.0`  
**Task**: Bipedal Locomotion, Reinforcement Learning, Sim-to-Real  
**Hardware Platform**: Antigravity 14-DOF MicroDuck Biped Robot  

---

## 📌 Overview (개요)
본 데이터셋은 **14-DOF 소형 2족 보행 로봇(MicroDuck)**의 완벽한 **평면 보행(Flat-ground walking)** 궤적 및 제어 로그를 담은 고품질 합성 데이터(Synthetic Data)입니다. 기존 강화학습 기반 2족 보행 에이전트들이 흔히 겪는 **발바닥 미끄러짐(Ice-Skating)** 및 **제자리걸음(Marching in place)** 문제를 공학적으로 완벽히 극복한 최상급 베이스라인 모델입니다. 향후 복잡한 지형 환경이나 비전(Vision) 기반 조향 학습을 위한 통제된 대조군(Control Group)으로 활용하기에 최적화되어 있습니다.

---

* **Zero-Slip Planted Stance**: 지면 접촉 상태($\text{contact} > 0.5$)에서 디딤발의 수평 속도가 **$0.000 \pm 0.002\text{ m/s}$**로 수렴하여 완벽한 지면 밀착 보행을 구현합니다.
* **Controlled Falling Momentum**: 상체 피치(Trunk Pitch)를 **미세 전방 바이어스($-3.0^\circ$)**로 제어하여 중력에 의한 자연스러운 전진 모멘텀을 형성하고, 디딤발의 **강력한 후방 킥(Push-off) 추력($+0.22\text{ rad}$)**을 데이

# playdead

Finger gun... bang! Sits, flops onto its back, legs up, head to one side.

sudo robotctl policy add playdead drfonz-indigo/microduck-playdead

rows.evidence:
# Microduck RL playground

Real trained RL policies for the Microduck robot, running fully in the
browser: MuJoCo compiled to WebAssembly steps the physics, onnxruntime-web
runs the policy network at 50 Hz. No server, no backend.

Two locomotion variants of the same robot are included: **legs** (walking,
the default) and **rollers** (the wheeled skating variant). Press `M` (or
hold D-pad up ~1 s on a gamepad) to switch; the roller model, meshes and
policies are lazy-loaded on the first switch.

## Policies

| Mode | Checkpoint | What it does |
|--------|-----------|--------------|
| Run (legs) | `BEST_alpha_walking.onnx` | Velocity-tracking locomotion (arrows / WASD to steer) |
| Sit | `BEST_alpha_sitstand.onnx` | Sits down on its hull, stands back up |
| Roll | `roulade.onnx` | Rolls over and recovers |
| Kick | `ball_kick_left.onnx` / `ball_kick_right.onnx` | Blind one-shot kick (0.5 s window, zeroed commands), left or right leg |
| Drive (rollers) | `BEST_roller.onnx` | Velocity-tra

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> EiwLoveDen/microduck-happy-birthday
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

# Microduck RL playground

Real trained RL policies for the Microduck robot, running fully in the
browser: MuJoCo compiled to WebAssembly steps the physics, onnxruntime-web
runs the policy network at 50 Hz. No server, no backend.

Two locomotion variants of the same robot are included: **legs** (walking,
the default) and **rollers** (the wheeled skating variant). Press `M` (or
hold D-pad up ~1 s on a gamepad) to switch; the roller model, meshes and
policies are lazy-loaded on the first switch.

## Policies

| Mode | Checkpoint | What it does |
|--------|-----------|--------------|
| Run (legs) | `BEST_alpha_walking.onnx` | Velocity-tracking locomotion (arrows / WASD to steer) |
| Sit | `BEST_alpha_sitstand.onnx` | Sits down on its hull, stands back up |
| Roll | `roulade.onnx` | Rolls over and recovers |
| Kick | `ball_kick_left.onnx` / `ball_kick_right.onnx` | Blind one-shot kick (0.5 s window, zeroed commands), left or right leg |
| Drive (rollers) | `BEST_roller.onnx` | Velocity-tra

hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# side-roll-right

Lateral roll (cartwheel) over the shoulder, RIGHT. Lands back in the start posture (stand or sit). Two-button family: this repo feeds [0,1,0].

A **episodic** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs 2.0 s and returns itself to a standing pose.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy add side-roll-right guang384/microduck-side-roll-right
robotctl robot do side-roll-right
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **task_id**: `Mjlab-SideRoll-Flat-MicroDuck`

# 🦆 Microduck Lab

Describe a routine in plain English. A language model compiles it into a move
plan, and the **real reinforcement-learning policies that ship with
[Microduck](https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck/)** execute it against
MuJoCo physics — then you get the video, the telemetry and a report.

```
[routine text] ─▶ (fn) choreograph ─┬─▶ 📝 Move plan
                    LLM             │
                                    ▼
[seed] ────────────────▶ (fn) perform ─┬─▶ 🎬 Routine video
              MuJoCo + 9 ONNX policies ├─▶ 📊 Telemetry
                                       └─▶ 📝 Report
```

## This is not a re-implementation

Nothing about the duck is faked or hand-animated. At runtime the app downloads,
from the official playground Space
[`pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator`](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator):

- `robot_allcollisions.xml` and `robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml` — the MJCFs
  for the walking robot and the roller-skate varian

VelStand fine-tuned to land drops of 20-60 cm: servo-housing impacts -80% stepping off 60 cm (simulation). Not yet tested on a real robot.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait for the `walk` slot.

sudo robotctl policy load walk IgaPro/microduck-veldrop

- “Kick that ball.”
- “Remember hello: quack, then sit.” Then: “Do hello.”
- “Stop.”

# Speedy Quack 1

Speedy Quack 1

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> jmvargascruz/microduck-speedy-quack-1
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`
- **branch**: `main`
- **commit**: `a3e0c0fbe`

rows.evidence:
# MICRODUCK GAME: Red Light, Green Light

MICRODUCK GAME: the duck plays the doll of Red Light, Green Light. It turns its back, chants and quacks one syllable at a time, whips round to catch anyone still moving, then bows to the jury and wheees. Pollen's own walker, unmodified, performs an original 20 s timeline.

An entry for **MicroDuck Got a Talent** on the [Microduck Arena](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-arena). **Simulation only** — see below.

## The act

The duck plays the doll of the playground game *Red Light, Green Light* (in Korea, *mugunghwa kkochi
pieotseumnida*, "the rose of Sharon has bloomed"):

| time | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.0–1.9 s | the doll surveys the players, tilts its head and quacks hello |
| 1.9–3.4 s | it turns its back on them (a half turn in place) |
| 3.8–6.7 s | it chants *mu-gung-hwa kko-chi pi-eot-seum-ni-da*, one quack — and one open beak — per syllable, head swaying by phrase |
| 6.6–8.6 s | the head snaps over its shoul

# MICRODUCK GAME: Duck Staircase Pyramid

MICRODUCK GAME: Duck Staircase Pyramid. Six microducks, one policy. Five bow down, heads to the floor, into a living staircase; the sixth walks up, climbs it step by step and ends standing on the heads of the top two, facing the jury, until the very end. No duck falls. All MuJoCo physics: a bow controller holds the steps, and the climber is a PPO fine-tune of Pollen's walker, with corrections searched in simulation.

An entry for **MicroDuck Got a Talent** on the [Microduck Arena](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-arena). **Simulation only** — see below.

## The act

Six ducks, one policy. Five of them bow down, heads to the floor and leaning on one another, into a staircase made of
their own bodies; the sixth climbs it and ends up standing on the heads of the top two, facing the jury, for the rest
of the act.

| time | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.2–1.4 s | **C+** and **C−** (`ducks[3]`, `ducks[4]`) walk in from the front

# MICRODUCK GAME: Duck Pyramid Choir

MICRODUCK GAME: Duck Pyramid Choir. Two ducks sit shoulder to shoulder and a third stands right behind and between them, so the three heads make a pyramid. Together they sing Ode to Joy in three parts — melody, harmony, oom-pah bass — swaying in time, then finish with a fanfare and a fit of laughing quacks.

An entry for **MicroDuck Got a Talent** on the [Microduck Arena](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-arena). **Simulation only** — see below.

## The act

Three ducks, one policy. Two sit shoulder to shoulder at the front of the stage, the *alto* (`ducks[1]`) and the
*bass* (`ducks[2]`); the third, the *top* (`ducks[0]`), stands close behind and between them, so the three heads
make a pyramid — two low, one high — and the top leads a three-part choir:

|---|---|

That graft scores 163.106 cm and has the same rating tables as rumezhak's [tug-remix-leader3][r3]. We then ran our own CMA-ES search of the offsets for the last 0.4 to 0.9 s of the rating bouts of seeds 1, 2, 3 and 5 against the frozen reference duck. **163.277 cm** on the five rating seeds in our x86 rating with the Arena's own tug code (+0.171 cm over the graft), all pit wins, in-sample. The Arena has not scored this file yet. The head-to-head (cup) network is rumezhak's league-trained one from leader2, unchanged. ## What it is - **The graph** is greecree's, shared by both sources. A step counter k rides in the low bits of the `head_roll` action and a branch id b in those of `head_yaw` (the Arena feeds every policy its previous action back). At k = 0 the observation is compared with five fingerprints (`hy_sig`, one per rating seed, tolerance 0.001) and a match sets b to that seed; at k = 2, b is kept only if the observation is within 0.05 of one of a second set (`hy_sig2`). rows.evidence:
# duck-detective

Duck Detective: looks around, sits to study a clue, shakes its head, a double take, and a bow. Pollen got-a-talent reference policy with our own 20 s timeline.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> juicenv/microduck-duck-detective
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

A remix of [pollen-robotics/microduck-got-a-talent-reference](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-got-a-talent-reference).

## Training

- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`
- **branch**: `lean`
- **commit**: `5a3636302`

hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# sprint-es

2 m Sprint runner: HannesVonEssen/microduck-running (Apache-2.0, iteration 12195) fine-tuned by evolution strategies on the Arena's own sprint scorer.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> juicenv/microduck-sprint-es
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

A remix of [HannesVonEssen/microduck-running](https://huggingface.co/HannesVonEssen/microduck-running).

## Training

- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`
- **branch**: `lean`
- **commit**: `5a3636302`

# MicroDuck m1-series walking policies (macOS-trained)

MicroDuck 双足机器人的行走策略 ONNX，在本机 Mac（CPU）上用 mjlab + rsl_rl PPO 训练，任务 `Mjlab-Velocity-Flat-MicroDuck`。

训练代码：[Jup33Q/microduck_rl](https://github.com/Jup33Q/microduck_rl)（fork 自 [pollen-robotics/microduck_rl](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl)）；部署 viewer：[Jup33Q/microduck-lkg](https://github.com/Jup33Q/microduck-lkg)。

## 架构（三个文件完全一致）

`obs[61] → Sub(mean) → Div(std) → [Linear+ELU]×3 (512/256/128) → Linear → actions[14]`

- 参数量：197,774（≈197.8K），fp32 ≈ 0.79 MB；obs normalizer 已烘焙进图
- 61D 观测：IMU 角速度(3) + 投影重力(3) + 关节位置/速度(14+14) + 上一拍动作(14) + twist 指令(3) + head_pose(4) + body_pose(6)
- 14D 动作：XL330 舵机目标位置增量（`target = DEFAULT_POSE + action×1.0`），BAM M6 电压模型执行器
- 部署：50Hz 策略 / 200Hz 物理，确定性策略均值（探索 σ 不导出）

# Microduck RL — 2.0 m/s running push

Fork of [pollen-robotics/microduck_rl](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl) training
Pollin Robotics **Microduck** (25 cm open-source biped, XL330 servos) to run at a
**measured mean 2.0 m/s** forward speed via PPO (rsl_rl + MuJoCo Warp / BAM).

## Honest status (2026-09-12, TRAINING STOPPED)

- Recipe: exact DuckEMW running config, **only deviation = speed cap raised to 2.5**
  (`MICRODUCK_RUNNING_SPEED_CAP=2.5`, `MICRODUCK_RUNNING_TARGET_MAX_SPEED=2.5`).
  No flight reward, no Su-style rewards, no achievement gate — reverted to the proven base.
- **Max measured mean forward speed (world-displacement eval): 1.621 m/s @ cmd 2.0**
  (p10 1.387, p90 1.828, max 1.923, ~2 resets) at checkpoint `model_76500.pt`
  (iter 76506). This is the best result of the run.
- Earlier best was 1.651 m/s @ cmd 2.0 (model_58000, cap 2.0). The cap-2.5 run reached
  1.621 mean at the final checkpoint; fluctuated 1.52–1.65 across the climb — did not pass 1.7

# groove

In-place groove: rhythmic knee bounce with a small head sway (sim-trained, untested on hardware)

A **episodic** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). Runs 10.0 s and returns itself to a standing pose.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy add groove kramp/microduck-groove
robotctl robot do groove
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **task_id**: `Mjlab-Dance-Flat-MicroDuck`
- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`
- **branch**: `dance`
- **commit**: `2f3f4ea1d`
- **checkpoint**: `3999`

## What it actually does (measured in simulation)

20 s headless rollouts in CPU MuJoCo with the BAM XL330 actuator model (`scripts/render_policy.py`),

Deployment files for [fuheaven/LightX2V-microduck](https://github.com/fuheaven/LightX2V-microduck), including the trained MicroDuck navigation checkpoint and its minimal Wan inference dependencies.

# LightX2V × MicroDuck — FastWAM navigation inference bundle

Deployment files for [fuheaven/LightX2V-microduck](https://github.com/fuheaven/LightX2V-microduck), including the trained MicroDuck navigation checkpoint and its minimal Wan inference dependencies.

**This release contains simulation development weights. It has not passed independent full capability acceptance or real-hardware validation.** It is a task-specific high-level controller, not a general-purpose autonomous robot brain.

本仓库提供 MicroDuck 视觉寻球模型的完整推理文件。使用代码仓库的 Docker 环境即可运行推理测速、MuJoCo 仿真与独立 MicroDuck Studio 页面；无需先训练 TinyVLA、安装 ROS2 或取得作者私有权重。

## Included model and behavior

- Model: `clear-room-realtime-control-pilot-v1 / step 250`.
- Model SHA256: `8ea7793290f0a22bff56ec4e44168232564ec5d57a9e21515a8a8c4a989114ea`.
- Inputs: head-camera RGB history, a supported target instruction, and 48-dimensional robot state.
- History: control-tick offsets `[300, 150, 50, 0]`, composed into a 512 × 512 image.
- Output: `32 × 5`

# MicroDuck SitStand Smoke Policy

This is the ONNX export of the learner's 64-environment × 5-iteration smoke checkpoint for `Mjlab-SitStand-Flat-MicroDuck`.

## Browser loading

The MicroDuck Sandbox accepts a Hub move repository containing `policy.onnx` and `manifest.json`. With this repository hosted publicly, open:

```text
https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator?boot=1&move=OWNER/REPO
```

The manifest mounts the policy in the `sitstand` slot; press `R` to toggle the sit/stand command.

## Evidence boundary

The export passed the course's 40-step real-observation ONNX parity check after an explicit reset at step 20 (`max_absolute_error = 1.4901161193847656e-07`, tolerance `1e-4`). The original smoke model scored 0% for both sit and stand in the 20-environment, 5-second skill battery. Browser loading and physics behavior still need a separate online check.

rows.evidence:
# 마이크로덕 학교

[pollen-robotics/microduck_rl](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl) 의 강화학습을
**버튼 몇 번**으로 돌리는 앱입니다. Pollen Robotics 공식 제품이 아닌 비공식 학습 도구입니다.

## 구조 — 어디서 무엇이 돌아가나

| 부분 | 어디서 | 비용 |
|---|---|---|
| 이 앱(화면) | Hugging Face **Space** (CPU basic) | 무료 |
| 실제 학습 | Hugging Face **Jobs** (클라우드 GPU, 기본 L4) | 분 단위 과금, L4 시간당 $0.80 |
| 결과물 | 내 계정의 비공개 모델 저장소 `duck-<task>-<날짜>` | 무료 |

Space 자체에는 GPU 가 필요 없습니다. "학습 시작"을 누르면 앱이 `HfApi.run_job()` 으로 GPU Job 을 띄우고,
Job 이 `microduck_rl` 을 받아 `uv run train …` 을 실행합니다.

## 🎬 튜토리얼 영상

`assets/tutorial_ko.mp4` (2분 40초, 한국어 자막 번인, `tutorial_ko.srt` 별도) — 앱 맨 위 "🎬 튜토리얼" 칸에서 바로 볼 수 있습니다.
구조 → 앱 → 파일 → 설정·GPU → 올리기 → 데이터 → 학습 → 시뮬레이션 → 비교 → 결과 → 로봇 설치 → 안 될 때 순서입니다.

## 처음 한 번: 진짜로 돌아가는지 확인하는 순서 (어른)

이 앱은 Hugging Face 가 차단된 환경에서 만들어져 **클라우드 GPU 학습을 실제로 돌려 본 적이 없습니다.**

hf_basic_evidence.evidence_excerpt:
# 마이크로덕 학교

[pollen-robotics/microduck_rl](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl) 의 강화학습을
**버튼 몇 번**으로 돌리는 앱입니다. Pollen Robotics 공식 제품이 아닌 비공식 학습 도구입니다.

## 구조 — 어디서 무엇이 돌아가나

| 부분 | 어디서 | 비용 |
|---|---|---|
| 이 앱(화면) | Hugging Face **Space** (CPU basic) | 무료 |
| 실제 학습 | Hugging Face **Jobs** (클라우드 GPU, 기본 L4) | 분 단위 과금, L4 시간당 $0.80 |
| 결과물 | 내 계정의 비공개 모델 저장소 `duck-<task>-<날짜>` | 무료 |

Space 자체에는 GPU 가 필요 없습니다. "학습 시작"을 누르면 앱이 `HfApi.run_job()` 으로 GPU Job 을 띄우고,
Job 이 `microduck_rl` 을 받아 `uv run train …` 을 실행합니다.

## 🎬 튜토리얼 영상

`assets/tutorial_ko.mp4` (2분 40초, 한국어 자막 번인, `tutorial_ko.srt` 별도) — 앱 맨 위 "🎬 튜토리얼" 칸에서 바로 볼 수 있습니다.
구조 → 앱 → 파일 → 설정·GPU → 올리기 → 데이터 → 학습 → 시뮬레이션 → 비교 → 결과 → 로봇 설치 → 안 될 때 순서입니다.

## 처음 한 번: 진짜로 돌아가는지 확인하는 순서 (어른)

이 앱은 Hugging Face 가 차단된 환경에서 만들어져 **클라우드 GPU 학습을 실제로 돌려 본 적이 없습니다.**
그래서 학생이 쓰기 전에 아래 순서로 한 번 확인해야 합니다. 비용은 약 $0.3 입니다.

1. `python deploy.py` 로 올립니다 (아래 "배포").
2. Space 를 열어 맨 위에 `앱 2026-10-05 · v14` 와 **🟢 진짜 학습에 연결됨** 이 보이는지 봅니다.
   - 🧪

rows.evidence:
# Microduck autonomous jump policy v24

Simulation-only policy and a fixed deployable action filter trained in
[`pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl).

The actor maps the shared 61D onboard observation contract to 14 relative
joint targets at 50 Hz. Runtime observations are IMU angular velocity,
projected gravity, joint positions/velocities, previous actions, and a
one-shot phase clock. The actor receives no MuJoCo root pose, foot-contact
state, target coordinates, reference motion, or external motion commands.

`deployment.json` describes the 11 fixed phase-gated gains and biases applied
to actor output. They were optimized in simulation, are independent of runtime
simulator state, and require only the same phase clock already present in the
actor observation.

## Fresh randomized qualification

- Episodes: 4,096 standing-only starts
- Strict success: 7.568% (310/4,096)
- Controlled success: 5.835% (239/4,096)
- Valid two-foot flight: 60.986%

# MicroDuck Sprint CPU Remix

A simulation-only remix of [jrubiosainz/microduck-game-sprinter-remix2](https://huggingface.co/jrubiosainz/microduck-game-sprinter-remix2) for the [Microduck Arena 2 m Sprint](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-arena#/e/sprint-2m).

**Official Arena result: 0.860 seconds, with all five official seeds finishing. Ranked #2 when verified on 17 October 2026 at 09:16 UTC.** This ties the first-place source model; the earlier submission retains first place. # strata-roller-pb4

Trained and judged in Strata on microduck-challenges' roller env, own lineage: PPO on race commands with the calm-skate shaping removed and a light upright term, then four rounds of ES on the Arena roller scorer.

A **perpetual** policy for the [microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) (61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz, on rollers). Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot.

## Run it on a robot

```bash
sudo robotctl policy load <slot> namenu/microduck-arena
```

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations.
`manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo).

## Training

- **repo**: `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`

rows.evidence:
# Microduck RL playground

Real trained RL policies for the Microduck robot, running fully in the
browser: MuJoCo compiled to WebAssembly steps the physics, onnxruntime-web
runs the policy network at 50 Hz. No server, no backend.

Two locomotion variants of the same robot are included: **legs** (walking,
the default) and **rollers** (the wheeled skating variant). Press `M` (or
hold D-pad up ~1 s on a gamepad) to switch; the roller model, meshes and
policies are lazy-loaded on the first switch.

## Policies

| Mode | Checkpoint | What it does |
|--------|-----------|--------------|
| Run (legs) | `BEST_alpha_walking.onnx` | Velocity-tracking locomotion (arrows / WASD to steer) |
| Sit | `BEST_alpha_sitstand.onnx` | Sits down on its hull, stands back up |
| Roll | `roulade.onnx` | Rolls over and recovers |
| Kick | `ball_kick_left.onnx` / `ball_kick_right.onnx` | Blind one-shot kick (0.5 s window, zeroed commands), left or right leg |
| Drive (rollers) | `BEST_roller.onnx` | Velocity-tra

# Microduck cooperative-pushing MAPPO checkpoints

This repository preserves training checkpoints for the Cargo Ducks / Microduck cooperative-pushing research workbench. Training code and the experiment record are in [npow/microduck-coop](https://github.com/npow/microduck-coop/tree/3f73507).

## Important status

The V97 continuation was paused by the user to free the GPU. **V97 is unfinished and has not been evaluated.** Eight of twelve branches have checkpoints at update 23,180; four branches had not started. These are resumable training states, not final policies or evidence of a training-horizon benefit. Do not cite V97 as a result. Its matched 60-second and 120-second actor weights differed before pause, confirming that the corrected environment cap affects training; task delivery still requires the planned held-out evaluation.

The earlier V96 horizon comparison is invalid because an environment reset overwrote the requested cap. V96 artifacts are intentionally not included.

# Microduck Sprint 1199 — initial baseline

A PPO walking policy prepared for the Pollen Robotics Microduck Arena `sprint-2m` event.
This is checkpoint 1199 from a low-speed tracking continuation experiment: source
checkpoint 1000 followed by 200 PPO updates. Training used a locally modified
`pollen-robotics/microduck_rl` checkout with forward tracking standard deviation
0.10 m/s. Training provenance and hashes are included in this repository.

visitor's browser. Hugging Face serves static files; it does not run a shared
simulation server.

# Nimble walk (NottyDuck)

A **perpetual** walking policy for the [MicroDuck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck)
(61-D observation, 14 actions, 50 Hz). It follows slow, backward and turning
velocity commands that the stock alpha walker ignores in simulation, and it
is the default walker of the NottyDuck browser game.

**Simulation only.** It has never run on a physical MicroDuck.

The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw
observations. Input `obs` `[1, 61]`, output `actions` `[1, 14]`, action
scale 1.0, no action filter.

## Command contract

- `twist` = `[vx, vy, wz]` in m/s and rad/s. Trained ranges: vx ±0.4,
  vy ±0.3, wz ±1.0. Sideways tracking is weak; NottyDuck sends vy = 0 and
  caps forward at 0.25 m/s, backward at 0.2 m/s and turning at 1.0 rad/s.

# flamingo-cycle

Stand on one foot, either side, on command, and come back to a two-foot stand: twist = [flag, side, 0].

<video controls muted loop src="https://huggingface.co/RemiFabre/microduck-flamingo-cycle/resolve/main/media/preview.mp4" style="max-width:640px;width:100%"></video>

**Command** — twist slots of the 13-D command block (head / body slots: unused (zeros), unused (zeros)); idle = `[0, 0, 0]`

| slot | meaning |
|---|---|
| twist[0] | flag: 0 = stand on two feet (HOME), 1 = stand on one foot |
| twist[1] | side: +1 = right foot down / left leg lifted, -1 = left foot down / right leg lifted; 0 allowed while flag = 0 |
| twist[2] | unused (0) |

**What it does** — `flag = 1`: shifts its weight over the chosen foot, lifts the other ~9 cm and holds (10 s+); `flag = 0`: lowers it and stands. Either side, same network, ~1.5 s each way, interruptible at any time. Choose `side` before raising the flag.

**Limits (sim only, never run on hardware)** — holds pushes ≤ 0.15 m/s fr

# Microduck Revia

面向 Microduck 的运动与跌倒恢复策略。当前模型在 MuJoCo 仿真中验证了站立、前进、后退、原地转向、运动指令切换，以及俯卧、仰卧、侧卧和行进受扰后的自行站起。成功恢复后可继续执行行进指令。

## 当前能力

下表给出独立仿真样本的实测结果。速度采用机器人机体坐标系；结果仅适用于所述测试条件。

| 测试 | 当前模型结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 持续前进，指令 +0.30 m/s | 平均纵向速度 +0.249 m/s |
| 持续后退，指令 −0.20 m/s | 平均纵向速度 −0.185 m/s |
| 前进、后退与指令切换 | 合计 384 条、每条 120 秒的轨迹中，未观察到跌倒或非有限数值 |
| 行进中重复扰动后的恢复 | 628 个有效跌倒恢复窗口中成功 589 个，成功率 93.79% |
| 重复扰动测试结束时保持直立 | 128 个环境中 120 个，比例 93.75% |

重复扰动测试包含 128 条、每条 120 秒的轨迹，每个环境施加 7 次水平速度扰动，两个水平分量各在 ±1.2 m/s 范围内采样。恢复成功要求在 8 秒内达到躯干倾角小于 25°、躯干高度大于 0.09 m，并连续保持 0.5 秒。628 个有效跌倒窗口按测试判据统计，未将所有扰动都计作跌倒。

在包含质心随机化的 8 秒恢复测试中，每类使用 384 个样本：

| 初始状态 | 恢复成功率 |
| --- | --- |
| 俯卧 | 100.00% |
| 仰卧 | 99.22% |
| 侧卧 | 97.66% |
| 仰卧且关节姿态随机 | 91.15% |

## 推理接口与当前运行入口

- 控制频率：50 Hz；输入为 `float32 [1,61]`，输出为 `float32 [1,14]`。
- 输入包括 48 维本体状态及 13 维指令，指令依次包含速度 3 维、头部姿态 4 维、身体姿态 6 维。完整观测与动作顺序见 [配置源码](source/src/mjlab_microduck/tasks/microduck_velocity_env_cfg.py)。
- `policy.onnx` 已包含观测归一化与输入校准，接收符合训练约定的原始观测；输出通过 Microduck 对应

下表给出独立仿真样本的实测结果。速度采用机器人机体坐标系；结果仅适用于所述测试条件。

| 测试 | 当前模型结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 持续前进，指令 +0.30 m/s | 平均纵向速度 +0.249 m/s |
| 持续后退，指令 −0.20 m/s | 平均纵向速度 −0.185 m/s |
| 前进、后退与指令切换 | 合计 384 条、每条 120 秒的轨迹中，未观察到跌倒或非有限数值 |
| 行进中重复扰动后的恢复 | 628 个有效跌倒恢复窗口中成功 589 个，成功率 93.79% |
| 重复扰动测试结束时保持直立 | 128 个环境中 120 个，比例 93.75% |

重复扰动测试包含 128 条、每条 120 秒的轨迹，每个环境施加 7 次水平速度扰动，两个水平分量各在 ±1.2 m/s 范围内采样。恢复成功要求在 8 秒内达到躯干倾角小于 25°、躯干高度大于 0.09 m，并连续保持 0.5 秒。628 个有效跌倒窗口按测试判据统计，未将所有扰动都计作跌倒。

在包含质心随机化的 8 秒恢复测试中，每类使用 384 个样本：

| 初始状态 | 恢复成功率 |
| --- | --- |
| 俯卧 | 100.00% |
| 仰卧 | 99.22% |
| 侧卧 | 97.66% |
| 仰卧且关节姿态随机 | 91.15% |

## 推理接口与当前运行入口

- 控制频率：50 Hz；输入为 `float32 [1,61]`，输出为 `float32 [1,14]`。
- 输入包括 48 维本体状态及 13 维指令，指令依次包含速度 3 维、头部姿态 4 维、身体姿态 6 维。完整观测与动作顺序见 [配置源码](source/src/mjlab_microduck/tasks/microduck_velocity_env_cfg.py)。
- `policy.onnx` 已包含观测归一化与输入校准，接收符合训练约定的原始观测；输出通过 Microduck 对应

In-sample, and not a better walker. ## What it is jrubiosainz's game-hillclimber-remix8 graph, bit for bit except for official seed 2's branch: a network, a step counter carried in the low bits of the head_pitch action, and a per-seed branch selector that takes over a race by matching start-state fingerprints. rows.evidence:
# Microduck Rigid Body Kinematic Viewer
An interactive, dependency-free 3D viewer for the [Microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) bipedal robot's kinematic rigid body. Drag any joint through its real range of motion and watch the whole chain move, with its name, rotation axis, hard limits, soft (trainable) limits and HOME angle shown live.

It's a single `index.html` — open it in a browser, no build step, no install.

## Controls

| action | effect |
|---|---|
| drag | orbit the camera |
| scroll | zoom |
| click a joint (3D or the side list) | select it / show detail |
| drag a slider | move that joint live |
| `RESET TO HOME` | return every joint to its tuned standing pose |
| `ZERO ALL` | snap every joint to 0° |
| model toggle (top) | switch legs-only ↔ full robot |

## License

MIT — see [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE).

rows.evidence:
# Laya Vision: Microduck find-and-kick

[thaitea/laya-vision](https://huggingface.co/thaitea/laya-vision) (201M) fine-tuned to drive a simulated
[Microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) from its own camera: find the ball, walk up to it, kick it.
Each step it sees one 256×256 frame from the duck's camera and answers one `choice` question over four actions,
`FORWARD`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT` and `KICK`. It plays in both of [quackd](https://github.com/r33drichards/quackd)'s

# Microduck RL playground

Real trained RL policies for the Microduck robot, running fully in the
browser: MuJoCo compiled to WebAssembly steps the physics, onnxruntime-web
runs the policy network at 50 Hz. No server, no backend.

# MicroDuck Cloud Policies (official ONNX used in duck_play demos)

ONNX policies from the MicroDuck cloud simulation runtime, used by the duck_play closed-loop demos (multi-round ball chase, L1 person follow, "bring ball to owner").

Each policy follows the shared contract `[1, 61] -> [1, 14]` (obs: 48 proprioception + 13 command slots).

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `alpha_walking.onnx` | velocity-commanded walking/standing (default locomotion) |
| `alpha_stand.onnx` | standing / settle before kicks |
| `ball_kick_left.onnx` | left-foot kick |
| `ball_kick_right.onnx` | right-foot kick |

## Origin & license
Exported from the open-source [pollen-robotics/microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck) runtime (`microduck/policies`), Apache-2.0. Hosted here for reproducible demos (see XenderYang/microduck-duck-play code).

rows.evidence:
﻿# MicroDuck Pose-Gesture (YOLO11m-pose, v8)

Head-cam person pose/gesture model for the duck robot (sim-first, sim2real-ready).
- Detects person + keypoints (COCO-17 subset) from duck first-person RGB (320x240 train / 640x480 deploy), IMX219-like 62° HFOV, 40° head pitch (dynamic), 25cm eye height.
- Gestures (2D-separable at low view): idle / right_fwd / left_fwd / both_fwd / both_side.
- Dataset: synthetic v8, renderer-exact keypoint labels + domain randomization (floor/brightness/noise/blur/JPEG/jitter), balanced.
- Validation: Box mAP50 ≈ 0.995, Pose mAP50 ≈ 0.85 (150-val).
- Contract: ONNX `[1,3,480,480] -> [1,56,4725]`; decode yolov8/yolo11 pose.
See https://github.com/YDxun/microduck-duck-play for training/benchmark code.

# MicroDuck RL — Velocity Walking (trained 4096 env x 6000 PPO)

Self-trained walking baseline for the open-source MicroDuck biped (Duck Together / RoboGo cloud project).

- Task: `Mjlab-Velocity-Flat-MicroDuck` (flat-ground velocity tracking)
- Training: mjlab + MuJoCo Warp + PPO, **4096 parallel envs x 6000 iterations**, ~1h59m on NVIDIA RTX 5090
- Contract: ONNX `[1, 61] -> [1, 14]` (observation normalizer baked in via scripts/export.py)
- Result: mean reward ~81.5, mean episode length ~919.9, no NaN
- Note: this is an intermediate baseline (stable stand/walk, weaker straight-line speed tracking than the official `alpha_walking`). Full training config/log diff included under `params/` and `microduck_rl.diff`.

|---|---|
| `model_5999.pt` | final PyTorch checkpoint |

rows.evidence:
# 🦆 Microduck Lab

Describe a routine in plain English. A language model compiles it into a move
plan, and the **real reinforcement-learning policies that ship with
[Microduck](https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck/)** execute it against
MuJoCo physics — then you get the video, the telemetry and a report.

```
[routine text] ─▶ (fn) choreograph ─┬─▶ 📝 Move plan
                    LLM             │
                                    ▼
[seed] ────────────────▶ (fn) perform ─┬─▶ 🎬 Routine video
              MuJoCo + 9 ONNX policies ├─▶ 📊 Telemetry
                                       └─▶ 📝 Report
```

## This is not a re-implementation

Nothing about the duck is faked or hand-animated. At runtime the app downloads,
from the official playground Space
[`pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator`](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator):

- `robot_allcollisions.xml` and `robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml` — the MJCFs
  for the walking robot and the roller-skate varian

MuJoCo physics — then you get the video, the telemetry and a report.

```
[routine text] ─▶ (fn) choreograph ─┬─▶ 📝 Move plan
                    LLM             │
                                    ▼
[seed] ────────────────▶ (fn) perform ─┬─▶ 🎬 Routine video
              MuJoCo + 9 ONNX policies ├─▶ 📊 Telemetry
                                       └─▶ 📝 Report
```

## This is not a re-implementation

Nothing about the duck is faked or hand-animated. At runtime the app downloads,
from the official playground Space
[`pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator`](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator):

- `robot_allcollisions.xml` and `robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml` — the MJCFs
  for the walking robot and the roller-skate varian

hf_update_notes.summary: # microduck-bow A bow for the Microduck (Pollen Robotics). Episodic, phase-driven policy (10 s cycle, 6.1 s gesture, hand-back at 7 s), trained with `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl` on a custom task (`Mjlab-Bow-Flat-MicroDuck`). The gesture: the beak comes down to 2 cm above the floor without touching it, with the legs bending symmetrically during the descent; the head turns about 83° to the left and back; the knees bend; the duck stands back up. ## Installing on the robot This is a `phase`-encoded policy: it goes into the `ground_pick` slot (the ground-pick button triggers it), not into a skill (`policy add` refuses non-constant encodings). ``` sudo robotctl policy load ground_pick <user>/microduck-bow ``` Back to the official ground pick: `sudo robotctl policy reset ground_pick`. The daemon drives the phase with the period set in `robotd.toml` and hands back at φ = 0.7 (the official set's value, not configurable). hf_update_notes.summary: # static-grasp A ground pick for the A button that gets low. The duck crouches until its open beak is about 1 cm above the floor, keeps its centre of mass over its feet, bites, and stands up holding a small object. It replaces the stock `alpha_ground_pick` network in the same slot. **Real-robot demo** (50 s): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MpWuZ9_dxuk <video controls muted loop src="https://huggingface.co/RemiFabre/microduck-static-grasp/resolve/main/media/preview.mp4" style="max-width:800px;width:100%"></video> *Simulation, half speed: the stock pick on the left, this one on the right, same Lego.* **Try it on a duck** (a dev board; run this on the duck): ```bash sudo robotctl update apply --ref static-grasp-default daemon && sudo robotctl policy load ground_pick RemiFabre/microduck-static-grasp ``` Then stand the duck up (Start twice), put a small object about 9 cm in front of its feet, centred, and press A. To go back: ```bash sudo robotctl policy reset ground_pick && sudo robotctl update apply --ref main daemon ``` The first command installs the daemon build of [microduck#481](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck/pull/481). This network was trained with a scripted beak, which opens to 22° over phase 0.02–0.10 of its 4 s cycle and closes on the object over 0.34–0.40. hf_update_notes.summary: # Microduck FootstepNet A footstep planner for [Microduck](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl): FootstepNet ([rhoban/footstepnet_envs](https://github.com/rhoban/footstepnet_envs), the planner Rhoban used on Sigmaban) retrained with CrossQ (upstream hyperparameters) on Microduck's feet and step limits. It plans one step at a time toward a goal foot pose, avoiding a disc obstacle; the robot follows it with a footstep-tracking policy (task `Mjlab-Footsteps-Flat-Backlash-MicroDuck`, branch `footsteps` of microduck_rl). - `footstepnet.onnx` — deterministic actor, `obs (N, 8) float32 → step (N, 3)`. The CrossQ BatchRenorm layers are folded into the dense layers. Metadata: `options` (JSON: limits, tolerances, foot geometry), `obs`, `step`. - `crossq_best_model.zip` — the sbx CrossQ checkpoint it was exported from. ## Contract Poses are planar `(x, y, yaw)` of the **sole centre** (7 mm ahead of the `*_foot` site), x forward. - **Steps (limits):** dx +5 / −5 cm, dy ±2 cm, dθ ±30°, relative to the **neutral** landing pose (feet parallel, 95 mm apart), then clipped to that ellipsoid. Sole 54 × 41 mm. - **Observation** (right-support convention; for a LEFT support negate the entries marked *): `[goal.x, goal.y*, cos(goal.yaw), sin(goal.yaw)*, support_is_goal_foot, obstacle.x, obstacle.y*, obstacle.radius]`, goal and obstacle expressed in the support sole frame. hf_update_notes.summary: # Microduck footsteps Everything a Microduck needs to walk on placed footsteps. In simulation it lands 5–7 mm / 1–2° from its targets. Runs until told otherwise — a gait, loaded into a policy slot. ## Run it on a robot ```bash sudo robotctl policy load <slot> Helldave/microduck-hill-climb-1m5-run-1028-1546 ``` The observation normalizer is baked into `policy.onnx`; feed raw observations. `manifest.json` follows schema 2 of the microduck policy manifest (`docs/policy-manifest.md` in the daemon repo). ## Training - **task_id**: `Mjlab-HillClimb1m5-MicroDuck` - **repo**: `https://github.com/Helldave911/microduck-challenges` - **branch**: `main` - **commit**: `c3089e8bc` - **checkpoint**: `1000` - **seed**: `1` - **base**: `mjlab-microduck 0.1.0 @ 1efd853be` - **started**: `2026-10-28T14:47:20Z` ## Reproduce Same code, same `uv.lock`, same command, same seed. Training it again yields a comparable policy, not the same weights: GPU reinforcement learning is not bit-reproducible across machines. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Helldave911/microduck-challenges cd microduck-challenges git checkout c3089e8bc uv sync uv run train Mjlab-HillClimb1m5-MicroDuck --env.scene.num-envs 1024 --agent.max-iterations 3000 --agent.seed 1 --agent.logger tensorboard --agent.run-name run-1028-1546 ```

initialization.selection_rule: 各原有大类内按已采集 GitHub Star 降序；同值按原选择号；缺值不参加；这是一份固定批次，不随后续 Star 变动改选。

catalog_policy.weekly_review: 每周一复核；合并项目只占一个名额；平台指标分列，实质进展需阅读证据确认
catalog_policy.B: 基础入表并每日轻量扫描，不要求专属档案
catalog_policy.hf_collection_state: 已入表并配置每日轻量扫描；新来源先归并再分配编号
catalog_policy.hf_a_selection: 用途或方法有差异、公开资料可说明进展和边界；点赞下载为辅助，先选3项，不凑名额
catalog_policy.hf_weekly_review: 每周一结合新增用途、实机验证、使用反馈和持续关注度复核；不将点赞下载与Star相加
catalog_policy.fork_policy: 明确副本归并上游；有独立改动的Fork只作附属观察，不单独升A；旧编号、来源和档案保留。
catalog_policy.hf_derivative_policy: 同系列版本归主项目；仅复制、调参或针对榜单的微调不单列重点；有明确独立用途和实现的项目按主项目识别，不只看base_model标签。
